accepted_plan.summary: Feature-split `crates/protocol` so tokio JSONL stream is optional, generate Workspace web TypeScript types from protocol wire DTOs with drift checking, import generated types from frontend, and record minimal backend proxy stance without implementing full Worker operation UI.
accepted_plan.role_plan: Orchestrator creates a dedicated child worktree and spawns a narrow-scope Coder. Reviewer will be spawned read-only after Coder reports implementation commit(s). After approval, Orchestrator integrates into `orchestration`, validates protocol/frontend/Nix, records closure, and cleans only the child worktree/branch.
